title: Refunds on Immediate Cancellation of a Loop+ Membership
content:
Refunds desk reference. This rule governs the fee refund due when a buyer ends a paid Loop+ Membership immediately, rather than letting it run to the paid-through date.

## 1. Rule

A buyer who ends a paid membership immediately is refunded in full when the cancellation is requested within the full refund window counted in calendar days from the most recent paid charge and the benefit uses since that charge do not exceed the allowed uses. Otherwise, on plans whose annual partial refund setting is true, the refund is the fee times the whole months not yet started of the paid period over the months in the cycle, paid only when at least the partial refund minimum; on other plans no refund is due and the buyer should instead turn off renewal and keep benefits to the paid-through date. A trial is never refunded because nothing was charged. Refunds go to the original payment method and a charge is refunded at most once per basis.

Ending a paid membership immediately moves it from active to cancelled on that date, and the refund this rule allows is booked with it.

## 2. The full refund condition

A full refund is due when both of the following hold:

1. **Time.** The cancellation is requested within the full refund window counted in calendar days from the most recent paid charge. The clock starts on the date of the most recent paid fee charge of the membership, as the company's record of that charge shows it, not as the buyer recalls it. The cancellation request date must be no later than that charge date plus the plan's full refund window in calendar days; a request on the last day of the window is within it.
2. **Benefit uses.** The benefit uses since that charge do not exceed the allowed uses. The uses are counted from the date of the most recent paid fee charge up to and including the handling date, and a use counts only when its benefit code is one of the plan's benefit codes counted as a use; each use recorded on the membership counts once per order or streaming session per benefit.

Both facts are taken from the system's records of the membership before the refund is booked, and the refund is booked against that same charge, identified as the fee charge refunded.

## 3. The prorated refund

When the full refund condition is not met, the plan decides what follows:

| Plan | Prorated refund outside the full-refund conditions | Partial refund minimum |
|---|---|---|
| Loop+ Access Monthly | no | not applicable |
| Loop+ Student Monthly | no | not applicable |
| Loop+ Student Annual | yes | the plan's partial refund minimum |
| Loop+ Monthly | no | not applicable |
| Loop+ Annual | yes | the plan's partial refund minimum |
| Loop+ Household Annual | yes | the plan's partial refund minimum |

The prorated refund is the plan's membership fee multiplied by the number of whole months of the paid period not yet started, divided by the number of months in the billing cycle, with the result rounded to the nearest cent only at the end. It is paid only when that rounded amount is at least the partial refund minimum; below the minimum nothing is paid.

## 4. Decision table

| Within the full refund window? | Counted benefit uses not above the allowed uses? | Plan has a prorated refund? | Refund |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | either | the charge refunded in full |
| yes | no | yes | prorated refund, if at least the minimum |
| no | yes or no | yes | prorated refund, if at least the minimum |
| yes | no | no | none; the buyer should instead turn off renewal and keep benefits to the paid-through date |
| no | yes or no | no | none; the buyer should instead turn off renewal and keep benefits to the paid-through date |

A trial has no refund in any row, because nothing was charged.

## 5. Hypothetical worked cases

- **Window boundary.** A paid charge is dated 10 March on a plan with a 3-day full refund window and no counted benefit use since. A cancellation requested on 13 March is within the window and is refunded in full; one requested on 14 March is outside it.
- **A single use.** A cancellation requested on the day after the charge, on a plan that allows 0 uses, after one order shipped with free shipping since the charge: the counted uses (1) exceed the allowed uses, so the full refund condition is not met.
- **Prorated amount.** A hypothetical annual fee of 139.00 covers a twelve-month paid period that began on 1 January; the buyer ends the membership immediately on 15 May outside the full refund conditions. The months from June to December have not yet started, 7 whole months. 139.00 multiplied by 7 is 973.00; divided by 12 that is 81.0833, rounded to 81.08. With a minimum of 5.00, 81.08 is paid.
- **Below the minimum.** A hypothetical annual fee of 48.00 with 1 whole month not yet started gives 48.00 multiplied by 1, divided by 12, that is 4.00. With a minimum of 5.00 nothing is paid.

## 6. Destination and repeat refunds

Every Loop+ Membership refund goes to the original payment method. A charge is refunded at most once per basis; the bases are a full refund of the charge, a prorated refund for unused months, and a switch credit.
